position_meaning: Comparison/radar labels are prioritization judgments, not final adoption actions or numerical maturity scores.
freshness_rule: Use claim-specific publication/update/version, checked_on and maintenance status. Mutable vendor terms need fresh verification; older valid methodology can remain usable; inactive benchmark data cannot become current through retrieval.
boundary: Landscape supplies contextual intelligence and triggers. Adoption/readiness experts and authorized humans retain go/no-go, operating release and legal decisions.
